jobs.occupation: Process & Performance Manager - Technical Integration & SAP S/4HANA (d/f/m) (Prozessmanager/in - RPA)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

We are currently looking for a **Process & Performance Manager – Technical Integration & SAP S/4HANA (d/f/m) ** to join our Solutions department at Satair in Hamburg.

We are a multinational team driving process management, operational stability, and technical integration within Satair's Solutions department.

Are you ready to shape the future of global aviation material management? Through our Material Management Industrialisation Platform (MMIP), Satair is transforming aviation supply chains into an integrated, high-performance ecosystem. In this role, you will act as the primary technical advocate and process champion for the Solutions department, bridging operational process modeling with our strategic greenfield transition to SAP S/4HANA.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU **

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees. Local benefits may vary.

- Competitive Remuneration
- Work / Life Balance: Hybrid Working, flex-time, maternity/paternity leave, job sharing
- Personal Development: Personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions & lots of internal mobility opportunities
- Health & Wellbeing: Health insurance, well-being programs

Your Role Highlights:

- You will drive a high-impact transformation: Lead key project streams and shape our future SAP S/4HANA target architecture
- You will enjoy empowered ownership: Benefit from full freedom to challenge current processes and advise global leadership
- You will accelerate your professional growth: Access state-of-the-art Airbus/Satair learning frameworks and structured progression plans
- You will thrive in an international environment: Collaborate with diverse talent across Europe, APAC, and the Americas in a values-driven culture

**HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM **

- You will represent the Solutions department as the primary Process Champion in MMIP transformation boards
- You will translate complex IT and SAP architectures into actionable business risk, opportunity, and value statements
- You will evaluate system changes to safeguard active SLAs, operational stability, and technical roadmaps during greenfield streams (New Parts Flow, Customer Order Handling)
- You will map and optimize E2E workflows ("Happy Path") in SYMBIO to drive global standardization and ensure audit readiness
- You will define and track process KPI frameworks, error rates, and system dependencies to flag bottlenecks early
- You will facilitate seamless communication between operational teams and MMIP governance bodies, preparing decision matrices for leadership
- You will guide global delivery teams through change management from manual data entry to automated data oversight

**ABOUT YOU **

- You hold a degree in Business, Process Management, IT, or Engineering, combined with experience in global matrix organizations
- You bring a strong background in SAP transformations (S/4HANA, RISE, Fit-to-Standard) and core modules (MM/SD)
- You master process modeling tools (SYMBIO or ARIS) and agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe, Jira, Confluence)
- You understand customer service operations, SLA management, and data-driven process KPIs
- You excel at translating technical jargon into business statements and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
- You demonstrate diplomatic presence, resilience, and genuine empathy for operational realities across international cultures
- You are fluent in English

ABOUT SATAIR

Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation. With our global functional organisation spanning 11 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 1,900 people supporting a $3.3 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family! If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our websitewww.SATAIR.com (http://www.satair.com/) or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel atwww.youtube.com/sataircompany (http://www.youtube.com/sataircompany) !

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity (Astrophysiker/in, Astronom/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the field of solar physics and planetary research with around 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus is the investigation of the development, diversity and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun and solar-like stars. The MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g. ESA, NASA), and carries out cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

The Department Solar & Stellar Interiors at MPS invites applications for the position of a

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity

In recent years, exoplanetary science has undergone a major shift -- moving from exoplanet detection towards understanding star-planet systems as a whole, including the host star, interplanetary medium and galactic context. Specifically, tidal and magnetic interactions between planets and their host stars have been recognized to be able to modulate the evolution of both, including the atmospheric evolution of the planet and its habitability. The newly established ERC StG project PLANETARE seeks a postdoctoral researcher with a background in stellar magnetism and/or exoplanetary science to develop novel ways of detecting and characterizing the mutual influence of stars and planets with a focus on the influence of planets in short orbits on the magnetism of their host stars. At the core of the project is a new way to find exoplanets: detecting them through their magnetic interaction with the host star. This position builds the observational foundation - the sample, the activity catalog, and the geometry of the systems - and confirms any transiting planets among the interacting systems.

Your Tasks

- Compile the most accurate and complete flaring activity catalog to date using space-borne photometry
- Search the sample of flaring stars for transiting planet candidates using space-borne photometry
- Constrain the orientation of the rotational and magnetic axes of interacting systems
- Measure stellar activity characteristics and their predictive power for interaction

The transit search, flaring catalog and geometry measurements will constrain some of the drivers of interaction and its observability, working towards a true occurrence rate of magnetic interaction in young star-planet systems. You will work closely with a second postdoc (https://karriere.mps.mpg.de/jobposting/ff58b9b82b6efc0b224bf8134f1471929fdc639c0) within a small, newly formed team of two postdocs and a PhD student, led by the PI (Ekaterina Ilin). Group members are supported to lead their own papers and proposals, and to present at international meetings in both the stellar and exoplanet communities.

Your Qualification

- A PhD in physics or astrophysics (PhD must be awarded by the start date)
- Previous experience in observational astronomy, ideally including space-borne optical photometry
- The ability to work in a team
- A good command of the English language

Our Offer

- Comprehensive onboarding, professional development and further training opportunities
- Diverse and varied tasks in an international work environment
- Renumeration according to TVöDBund, based on qualifications and experience, annual bonus and additional pension scheme (VBL)
- 30 days of vacation plus 4 additional days off
- Full-time and part-time employment; flexible working time and possibility of mobile work
- Cooperation with local bilingual Montessori child care center
- Good connection by public transport
- Corporate health management

Additional Information

- Start date between January and October 2027
- Duration: 4 years
- Remuneration is according to EG 13 TVöD-Bund
- Application deadline is October 30, 2026 (interviews in late November / early December 2026)

We look forward to receiving your informative application documents (cover letter, CV, references, certificates). Please submit these via the digital application portal (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs) ). If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Dr. Ekaterina Ilin (ilin@mps.mpg.de (ilin@mps.mpg.de) ).

The Max Planck Society endeavours to achieve gender equality and diversity. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society seeks to increase the number of women in those areas where they are underrepresented and therefore explicitly encourages women to apply. The Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals

jobs.description:

The MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g. ESA, NASA), and carries out cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

The Department Solar & Stellar Interiors at MPS invites applications for the position of a

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to detect exoplanets through magnetic star-planet interaction

In recent years, exoplanetary science has undergone a major shift -- moving from exoplanet detection towards understanding star-planet systems as a whole, including the host star, interplanetary medium and galactic context. This position develops the detection method itself, i.e., the statistics, the search, and the physical model behind it.

Your Tasks

- Develop new statistical techniques to identify signatures of planet-induced flaring
- Identify young stars and search them for planet-induced flaring using archival and upcoming Kepler, TESS, and PLATO observations
- Measure how the strength and frequency of planet-induced flaring change as systems age

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Manager Investor Relations - Digital Financial Communications & AI (m/f/d) (Investor-Relations-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
This role sits at the intersection of Investor Relations, Digital Communications, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). It offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of Investor Relations: Working at the forefront of digital transformation, you will help modernize how the company engages with investors, analysts, and other capital markets stakeholders while contributing to the development of a more efficient, insight-driven, and AI-enabled Investor Relations function as a (Senior) Manager Investor Relations - Digital Financial Communications & AI.

Your responsibilities:

- Manage and continuously enhance the Investor Relations website and digital Investor Relations ecosystem, ensuring a best-in-class experience for investors, analysts, and other capital markets stakeholders.
- Manage and further develop the company's digital Investor Relations presence across social media channels and digital platforms, including coordination of external partners and service providers.
- Monitor digital engagement metrics and derive actionable recommendations to strengthen the company's visibility and positioning in capital markets.
- Identify and implement innovative digital communication formats, including interactive content, video, podcasts, and multimedia solutions.
- Act as a key driver in building an AI-ready and AI-native Investor Relations function through the introduction of AI-enabled workflows and tools.
- Leverage AI to enhance the creation of earnings materials, investor communications, presentations, management briefings, Q&A documents, social media content, and knowledge management solutions.
- Establish AI best practices, governance standards, and training initiatives while monitoring emerging technologies and identifying new use cases.
- Manage digital financial communications content across all Investor Relations channels and ensure a compelling and consistent equity story.
- Develop editorial plans and content calendars supporting quarterly reporting, Capital Markets Days, Meet the Management Days, and other key Investor Relations activities.
- Generate data-driven capital markets insights by analyzing analyst reports, investor feedback, earnings call transcripts, peer communications, and market developments, while collaborating closely with Investor Relations, Communications, Finance, Strategy, and senior leadership teams.

Your qualifications:

- University degree in Finance, Business Administration, Communications, IT, Digital Media, Data Analytics, or a related field.
- At least 2 years of experience in Investor Relations, Financial Communications, Corporate Communications, or Digital Communications.
- Solid understanding of capital markets, financial reporting, investor communications, and stakeholder engagement.
- Proven experience managing digital communication channels, content management systems, and external digital partners.
- Strong interest in AI, automation, digital transformation, and emerging technologies.
- Experience leveraging digital and AI-powered tools to improve communication processes, content creation, and business efficiency.
- Excellent writing, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into compelling messages.
- Analytical mindset with strong affinity for data-driven decision-making, reporting, dashboards, and capital markets insights.
- Proficiency in Microsoft 365, digital communication platforms, and AI-enabled productivity tools.
- Fluent English skills; German language skills are considered an advantage.

Our offer

Drive the future with us – become part of #futurefresenius and apply now via our online portal!

Contact

Apply now (http://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=108021&tc=3-11) via our online portal!

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Machine Learning (m/f/d) - TV-L E 13, 100% (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Universität Hildesheim
Stiftung des öffentlichen Rechts

Job advertisement
Reference number 2026/121

The following position is to be filled at the Institute of Computer Science,
Information Systems and Machine Learning Lab (ISMLL) has a vacancy for a

PhD Position in Machine Learning (m/f/d)
(TV-L E 13, 100%)

the position is full-time, can be filled immediately, and is initially
offered for three years. The salary is according to TV-L E13 (roughly 57,000
EUR gross income per year).

As a PhD student in our international ML research group you conduct research
in ML guided by a postdoc and two professors, have the opportunity to cooperate
with companies, small and large, as well as with academic partners on real-word
ML problems, and are encouraged to assist in teaching ML courses in our
renowned International Master‘s Program in Data Analytics to students from all
over the world. The working language of our group is English. You will work in
a beautiful town with UNESCO World Heritage Sites, located in the very center
of Germany, just 30 km from Hanover and 1.5 hours. by high-speed train to Berlin

Who we are:

The Information Systemsand Machine Learning Lab (ISMLL) at the Institute of
Computer Science of the University of Hildesheim is an international research
group an machine learning, especially predictive modelling and probabilistic
methods for complex data and complex decisions, with an excellent publication
track record (NeurlPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, ACM KDD, ECML PKDD, etc.). Current
research directions include time series forecasting, probabilistic machine
learning, graph neural networks, recommender systems, and mathematical
foundations of machine learning. ISMLL takes part in basic and applied research
projects in various domains such as mobility, e-commerce, and
technologyenhanced learning. Seehttp://www.ismll.uni-hildesheim.defor more
information. The Institute of Computer Science, of which ISMLL is part, has a
streng focus on artificial intelligence, with three chairs working in this
field. The University of Hildesheim is renowned for high-quality research and
education.

What we expect:

We are looking for a gifted student who loves models, algorithms, and data,
can hardly stop discussing them with others, likes to express their ideas in
formulas and programs, and now wants to get to the bottom of a complex ML
problem over the next three years. You should have a recent Master's degree in
Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a closely related
area. A Master's thesis on an ML topic and ML-related courses in your Master's
program will be an asset. You are expected to have strong analytic and
programming skills, the ability to work independently, and strong interpersonal
as weil as English language skills.

As a family-friendly university, we offer a varied, interdisciplinary range
of tasks, flexible working hours, regular further and advanced training and a
special annual payment within the framework of TV-L. In joining the university,
you will become part of a dynamic, committed and open-minded team.

The University of Hildesheim has adopted a mission statement that places
great importance on gender equality and diversity.

The University of Hildesheim particularly wants to promote the professional
equality of women and men. Therefore, it aims to increase the proportion of
employees of the gender that is underrepresented in the respective area.

In the case of equal qualification and suitability, applications from
applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration.

For university degrees obtained abroad, a certificate evaluation by the
Central Office for Foreign Education (ZAB) is required as proof of equivalence
before you are hired. Please apply for this in good time if necessary. You can
find more information athttps://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung.

Until when and how to apply
Please apply online using reference number 2026/121 at
https://www.ismll.uni-hildesheim.de/apply/, uploading your CV with your
transcripts and a research statement. Please enclose a PDF of a technical text
of yours, such as a first paper, your Master's thesis, or a seminar paper you
wrote. You can submit your application online at any time; once we have found
our new .PhD student, the application portal will be closed. We will store and
process your personal data during the application process and delete it
afterwards. For any further questions, please contact Prof. Dr. Dr. Lars
Schmidt-Thieme (schmidt-thieme@ismll.uni-hildesheim.de) or Prof. Dr. Tom Hanika
(tom.hanika@uni-hildesheim.de) via email.

jobs.occupation: Data Centre – Design Manager (m/f/d) MEP / Architectural Background (Architekt/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 51,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.

This job opening focusses on the German Market, seeking someone with a strong Design Management background in the local DC sector.

This will require deep engagement to materialize and to ensure and timely delivery, meeting the recurring clients’ deadlines, budget and requirements.

The design manager identifies the right level and capability of resources to be deployed on the project. It is the design managers responsibility to ensure the right level of bidding and pricing of new opportunities ensuring they are delivered as sold fees and margins. Thus, implying Project Management capabilities.

**Job Responsibilities:** 

- Design Management in a high paced project environment in the German market
- Covering multidisciplinary cross regional teams of CSA & MEP
- Assisting bids commercially and technically for multi-disciplinary opportunities with key clients
- Ensuring all internal as well as local regulatory governance is followed: both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects

Qualifications

- Senior Multidisciplinary Design Manager (MEP / Architectural Background)
- DC Experience in accountable DM position
- Proficient in contractual German and English
- Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines
- Excellent communication skills are essential

Additional Information

Why join us?
You will love the freedom to bring your own ideas and vision to life, combining client management, project delivery, and team leadership. You will value working alongside colleagues with outstanding technical expertise in a collaborative, caring, and supportive team environment. We offer a flexible working environment, a competitive salary, and a culture that places safety, wellbeing, and professional development at the heart of everything we do.

If you are looking to work for one of the world’s most trusted global environmental consulting firms and help shape a more sustainable future for Germany and beyond, the AECOM Germany team looks forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.occupation: International Marketing Manager - NUK, Baby Jogger (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
International Marketing Manager – NUK, Baby Jogger

Location: Zeven or Hamburg, DE, or London (Hammersmith), UK

Contract type: Permanent

Your Role & Team in a Nutshell

As an International Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in growing our brands NUK, Tigex, Baby Jogger, Aprica, Graco and Billy Boy across EMEA and APAC. You will turn global strategies into clear regional plans that connect with consumers, strengthen our presence in the market and drive growth. Working closely with local marketing teams, you will help shape how our brands show up in each market, ensuring plans are clear, relevant and delivered effectively.

This is an independent, hands-on role where you will take ownership of delivering innovation and brand plans across the regions. You will work closely with global and local teams, acting as the main point of contact to make sure plans are clear and delivered effectively. Success in this role comes from understanding consumers, making confident decisions and taking a proactive, self-driven approach to getting things done.

We will help you achieve your goals and develop by providing regular feedback and access to training courses.

Your Key Responsibilities

Strategy

- Lead the regional translation and execution of brand and portfolio strategies, setting clear priorities, choices and trade-offs, delivered on time and in full.
- Define distribution strategies, including merchandising and channel assortment, and translate strategic priorities into clear execution roadmaps, proactively challenging risks and misalignment.

Insights and Data

- Build strong knowledge of categories, target consumers and competitors to guide decision-making using internal and external insights.
- Analyse market and execution performance, using data to set priorities, improve effectiveness and drive timely corrective actions.

Product Development (Innovation and Portfolio Execution)

- Own the regional deployment of innovation and influence pipeline priorities to support effective execution and growth.
- Lead portfolio lifecycle management, ensuring markets are launch-ready and equipped with the right materials, timing and execution standards.

Brand Communication (In-market Excellence)

- Ensure consistent, high-quality brand communication across all Baby brands in the region.
- Support local teams in adapting communications to market needs while protecting brand equity, and act as a quality gate for messaging and execution.

Pricing

- Use shopper insights and market data to shape pricing strategies, guardrails and product configurations to maximise value.
- Lead pricing audits and support accurate in-market execution, identifying risks and key promotional opportunities with local teams.

Market Enablement

- Act as the primary regional contact for local marketing teams, ensuring alignment and accountability for delivering regional strategy and innovation priorities.
- Establish effective ways of working, supporting prioritisation, capability development and continuous improvement in execution quality.

What You'll Need

Minimum:

- Degree in Marketing, Business or a related field, with experience in international or multi-market marketing roles in consumer goods or lifestyle brands.
- Strong commercial understanding, including building business cases and working with P&L, alongside experience in pricing and product range management.
- Experience in product development and launches, including adapting global campaigns for local markets while maintaining brand consistency.
- Proven track record of delivering results and driving growth in a fast-paced environment, with a good understanding of compliance requirements.
- Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

Your Advantage:

- Strong analytical skills, using data and insights to understand performance and identify growth opportunities.
- Able to work across multiple markets, influencing stakeholders and setting clear priorities in a complex environment.

jobs.occupation: Plant PMO (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About The Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive professional to support in driving governance, strategic planning and the execution of plant-wide priorities. The role serves as a key coordination hub across functions, ensuring transparency, alignment and effective delivery of the Plant Master Plan, budgeting processes and strategic initiatives.

Main Responsibilities:

- Support the Plant Manager in driving governance, transformation initiatives, strategic priorities and plant-wide alignment across all functions
- Lead the development, coordination and execution monitoring of the Plant Master Plan, translating transformation priorities into actionable initiatives and measurable outcomes
- Coordinate plant budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring alignment of financial resources with transformation and business priorities
- Establish and maintain effective reporting and performance management routines to track progress against business objectives
- Drive cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives, ensuring stakeholder alignment and timely delivery
- Promote project management standards and governance principles to strengthen execution excellence across the plant
- Prepare management reviews, executive presentations and strategic communications for plant and central leadership teams
- Foster collaboration, transparency and continuous improvement by coordinating plant-wide activities and priorities

About You:

- University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field
- Several years of professional experience in governance, project management, business planning, controlling or cross-functional coordination, preferably within a multinational manufacturing environment
- Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to structure complex topics and coordinate multiple priorities simultaneously
- Good understanding of business processes and interdependencies across manufacturing functions and SQCDME dimensions
- Experience in coordinating cross-functional projects and driving initiatives in collaboration with diverse stakeholders
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact effectively across plant, area and central functions
- Ability to prepare clear presentations, management reports and decision-making materials for leadership teams
- Proactive, structured and collaborative working style with a strong sense of ownership
- Fluent in English
